home.tagline: Guide {team} through a European {game}. Eight ties. One wrong answer and you're out.

how.road: Each round of the {game} is one question: {stages}. Get it right and {team} go through.
how.knockout: One wrong answer and you're eliminated from the tournament. Win the Final and you're crowned {champion}.
how.lifeline: Use it once to remove two wrong answers. Choose the moment carefully: you don't get another one if you play on into a new season.
how.seasons: Win the Final and you can start a new season as holders, going straight into the {restart}. Keep winning to add more {prizes}. A wrong answer ends your run, but you keep the {prizes} you've won.
how.top100: Anyone can add their name and town to the Top 100. The most {prizes} ranks highest, then the furthest round reached. After that, players who didn't use the 50:50 rank above those who did, then the fastest time wins.
how.sound: Hear the crowd roar when you get an answer right. On a phone, the silent switch or volume may also need turning up.
